page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The configuration features 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, delivering 24 dedicated vCPUs alongside 96.0 GB of RAM, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware features include 35 MB of shared L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and vector instruction extensions including AVX-512 and AES. The platform provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile, operates without bundled local storage, and contains no integrated GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks highlight a clear distinction between single-threaded execution and multi-core throughput. Single-core tests reflect lower relative speed, characterized by bottom-tier performance in single-threaded gzip compression and modest Geekbench single-core results. Conversely, multi-core scaling reaches average relative performance levels across stress-ng multi-core tests, PassMark CPU suites, software compilation with Clang, and static web serving throughput measuring 13.07 GB/sec. Large block uncached memory write throughput operates at 50.79 GB/sec.

The 1:4 memory allocation ratio provides balanced resource density for general enterprise computing without requiring specialized high-memory overhead. Because local storage is absent, disk operations depend entirely on network-attached block storage options. The instance is suitable for web applications, relational and key-value databases such as Redis, build automation services, and containerized microservice host deployments.
